Klasse UserDao

java.lang.Object
de.hitec.nhplus.datastorage.UserDao
public class UserDao extends Object
Data Access Object for User records in the users table.

Encapsulates all SQL needed to read users (by id, by username, all) and to create or modify them (create, change password, reset password, activate / deactivate). Every modifying operation also writes an audit entry via LogService, so that user-management actions are traceable.

Single responsibility: it is the only place that knows the users table layout. It does not implement the generic Dao interface because users need additional, login-specific queries beyond plain CRUD; keeping it separate avoids forcing unrelated operations into the shared DAO contract.

    • updatePassword

      public void updatePassword(int userId, String passwordHash, String salt) throws SQLException
      Stores a new password hash and salt for a user and clears the "must change password" flag. Writes a USER_PASSWORD_CHANGE audit entry.
      Parameter:
      userId - id of the user whose password is updated
      passwordHash - the new salted password hash
      salt - the salt belonging to the new hash
      Löst aus:
      SQLException - if the update fails

    • resetPassword

      public void resetPassword(int userId, String hash, String salt) throws SQLException
      Sets a new one-time password (hash and salt) for a user and forces a password change on next login. Writes a USER_PASSWORD_RESET audit entry.
      Parameter:
      userId - id of the user whose password is reset
      hash - the salted hash of the generated one-time password
      salt - the salt belonging to hash
      Löst aus:
      SQLException - if the update fails
